run-down-s:
Final 2D ANIME GAME SPRITE source sheet. SAME ranger identity/kit as reference, but MUCH SIMPLER: flat olive shirt/helmet/vest, charcoal mask/boots, tan straps/gloves, one teal shoulder tab. Remove tiny equipment, camouflage speckles, textures, stitching, tiny hardware. Clean Chaos Zero Nightmare-inspired anime outlines. Neutral local albedo colors; NO baked light, rim highlights, gradients or cast shadows. Lighting is applied by the game. Compact 5-head anime proportions.
EXACT 4 COLUMN by 2 ROW grid with 8 distinct full-body sprites, every character contained in its cell with transparent spacing. ALL poses face this same fixed angle: front, no rotation of viewpoint. Invisible grid, no labels or text.
TOP ROW is a RUNNING cycle, NOT walking: (1) sprint left foot landing, long stride, body leans forward; (2) running airborne passing pose, bent knees and both feet lifted; (3) sprint right foot landing, opposite long stride; (4) running airborne opposite passing pose. Rifle held low with both hands, or slung securely, identical gear.
BOTTOM ROW is four ordered DOWNED animation keyframes: (1) wounded stumble knees buckling; (2) drops onto one knee, torso sags; (3) collapsing sideways, body falling toward ground; (4) fully settled lying on side, legs bent slightly, motionless. No blood, no floor, no shadows. Do not omit any frame. For lying figure fit the entire silhouette inside its cell.
Transparent RGBA, eight isolated poses of ONE original character, not 3D, not a photograph.

aim-flat:
EDIT this original tactical ranger into a SIMPLIFIED, LIGHTING-NEUTRAL 2D ANIME SPRITE for a Chaos Zero Nightmare-inspired game. Keep the exact same identity, camera angle, pose, helmet/headset silhouette, gloves and equipment placement. Keep the character 2D hand-drawn anime, not a 3D character.
Remove small details: erase stitching, mesh/fabric grain, micro-camouflage, worn edges, tiny vents, excessive straps and tiny buckles. Reduce the backpack to two broad panels, plate carrier to three clear shapes, helmet to clean olive panels, sleeves to only 2-3 broad fold lines. Keep clean dark linework and a small teal shoulder tab.
CRITICAL ALBEDO REQUIREMENT: NEUTRAL FLAT LOCAL COLORS ONLY. Remove all directional lighting, rim light, warm edge highlights, glossy highlights and cast shadows. Olive fabric is a consistent mid olive, tan webbing is a consistent mid tan, dark hardware is charcoal. Preserve outlines and minimal flat material separation, NOT lighting. The engine will light the character dynamically using separate normal/light masks. No painted white highlights or baked bright edges. Lighting is NOT part of this image.
No weapon pixels. Gloves remain visibly gripping empty space for a future live 3D gun. Keep palms and wrist boundaries clear. Preserve transparent background and existing transparency. One character, no labels, no environment, no logos.
